title: El compañero
goal: Make your first real friend at work
culture: ¿Qué pasó? is hello between men who work together. Nothing has happened and he does not want to know what has. This is also where you switch to vos for good with somebody your own age, and getting that switch right is worth more than any verb table.

beats.good: ¿Qué pasó? is hello, not a question. Nothing has happened, and answering it as though something had is the mistake every learner makes once.

beats.objective: All good — and ask him back
beats.good: ¿Y vos? He is a workmate your own age, so it is vos from here on, permanently. That switch is worth more than any verb table you will ever learn.
Vamos is let’s go and dale is alright. Between them they arrange nearly everything that happens after work.

beats.es: Bueno, ya me voy. Nos vemos mañana.
beats.good: Nos vemos — see you. Cuídese is for the doña on the corner; between the two of you it is this, and using the wrong one is audible.
